config.enabled.name: Enable Overcast
config.enabled.tooltip: Show drifting cloud shadows with your chosen settings. Turn off to restore the game's usual clouds; any clouds already on screen will drift away.
config.spring.name: Clouds in spring
config.spring.tooltip: Show cloud shadows on clear spring days.
config.fall.name: Clouds in fall
config.fall.tooltip: Show cloud shadows on clear fall days.
config.winter.name: Clouds in winter
config.winter.tooltip: Show cloud shadows on clear winter days.
config.appearance.title: Cloud appearance
config.speed.name: Cloud speed
config.speed.tooltip: How quickly clouds drift across the ground. 1 is the usual speed; 2 is twice as fast; 0 keeps them still.
config.min-size.name: Smallest clouds
config.min-size.tooltip: The smallest clouds that can appear. Lower values make smaller clouds. The game normally uses sizes from 4 to 6.
config.max-size.name: Largest clouds
config.max-size.tooltip: The largest clouds that can appear. Higher values make bigger clouds. Match the smallest size for equally sized clouds, or leave a gap for variety.
